correctness.rationale: The labelled dynamics factors through 225 nonempty pairs of initial occupied-color supports, with individual tags preserved after merges. Replaying the supplied 225-case finite exhaustive program reproduces all ten matrices and F^16=F^4. Surjection weights lift these exact cases to arbitrary labelled m,n; a separately implemented direct graph simulator agrees on 92,752 configurations across ten sizes, including all of K4,4. The 6-cycle formula uses exactly four support pairs of sizes (3,3); the first-entry and period sharpness follows from positive coefficient entries.

value.rationale: The classification specifies all ten temporal entry/period populations on a canonical infinite graph family, including a non-obvious genuine primitive period-six resonance restricted to exactly four three-plus-three support pairs. It distinguishes the two-shore system from the previously known three-positive-shore four-color system, gives sharp finite-size thresholds, and shows the period-six probability decays as 4(3/4)^(m+n) while period-four behavior dominates for large shore sizes. These are natural dynamical invariants with interpretive and reproducibility value beyond a routine period bound.
